snippet.description:
In this live session, Nishat Sir, faculty of Sociology Optional at LevelUp IAS, will take you through the UPSC CSE Mains 2026 Sociology Optional Paper -1.  The session includes a detailed discussion and analysis of the paper, highlighting key themes, trends in questions, and emerging areas of focus. Sir will also explain how aspirants can approach such questions with clarity and precision to maximize their marks.

Enrollment open for Sociology Crash Course cum Test Series:  https://shorturl.at/kEfZc

Check the Details of Sociology Optional Foundation Program: https://shorturl.at/YwWO1

📲Queries? Call directly- 8826496658

Nishat Singh Sir brings a unique blend of academic excellence and UPSC expertise. A B.Tech graduate from IIT BHU, with an M.A. in Sociology from the Delhi School of Economics and M.Phil/Ph.D. from JNU, he has mentored over 240 UPSC rankers — including 87+ in UPSC 2024 alone. His deep understanding of the subject and unmatched teaching style make him one of the most trusted names in Sociology for UPSC.

Join Nishat Sir's Telegram Channel to download this year's Sociology Topper's copies and marksheets: https://t.me/SociologyOptionalAnswerWriting

Connect with Nishat Sir, Santosh Sir, and the LevelUp IAS Mentorship Team. Get your personalized UPSC strategy for free. Fill out the form here: https://www.levelupias.com/lp/free-1-1-mentorship-session/

Meet us - 📍Location: LevelUp IAS, Karol Bagh Centre; Google Map - https://maps.app.goo.gl/xuPxi7iqkWeyMH9S9
Address - 2nd Floor, 45 Pusa Road, Opp. Metro Pillar 128, Karol Bagh
